meaning:
προσ-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(προσάγω),
1. a bringing to.
2. approach, access (see Lft., Notes, 284; MM, xxi): Rom.5:2, Eph.2:18 3:12 (but see Ellic., Eph., 59 f., where the transitive sense "introduction " is advocated).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.
